retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast red duotone portrait featuring glowing neon-style typography that follows the curve of the subject's head.

recipe.visualDefinition: A profile portrait of a musician in a suit, rendered in a saturated red-and-black duotone with heavy grain. The typography consists of glowing neon tubes, with one set of text arched over the subject's head in red and another set in green in the upper left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's profile faces right, creating a diagonal line from bottom-left to center.
The arched text follows the contour of the subject's head, creating a halo effect.
The guitar neck in the foreground provides a horizontal anchor across the bottom third.
The red neon glow illuminates the dark background behind the subject's head.
coreInvariants: Saturated red duotone color palette for the subject
Neon tube lighting effect on all display typography
Heavy film grain or halftone texture throughout

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale profile portrait occupying the left and center-left of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The guitar neck running horizontally across the bottom foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the green text top-left, follow the curve of the red neon text down to the subject's face, and rest on the guitar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows in the upper right and lower right corners provide contrast for the neon glow.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep saturated red for midtones and highlights of the subject.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for shadows and background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant green for the secondary text in the top left corner.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and greens against a zero-value black background.

letterConstructionRules: Monolinear strokes resembling glass neon tubes
Inner white core with a soft outer colored glow
Variable baseline following an elliptical arc
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'B' characters have distinct gaps between the loops and the stem to mimic tube bending.
The 'S' has a wide, open curve.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a secondary horizontal green neon header and a primary arched red neon title.

avoid: Perfectly straight baselines for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the monolinear rounded look of the source lettering.
Provides a similar retro-glow energy if modified for thickness.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast red duotone profile portrait of a man playing guitar, with heavy film grain and deep black shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply all-caps sans-serif text in a neon tube style. The primary text should be red and arched over the subject's head; the secondary text should be green and horizontal in the top left.

verificationChecks: Is the red duotone saturated and high-contrast?
Does the text have a visible white inner core and soft outer glow?
Is the main text arched to follow the subject's head?
Is the guitar neck visible as a horizontal element?

adjustableVariables: Primary duotone color (e.g., blue instead of red)
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos in the top right corner
Specific facial features of the original artist

avoid: Standard flat fonts without glow effects

postGenerationChecks: Check that the neon glow doesn't obscure the legibility of the letters.
Ensure the red duotone doesn't lose all detail in the subject's face.
Verify the green and red neon colors do not clash harshly.
Confirm the arched text feels integrated with the subject's shape.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast [Color] duotone portrait + [Color] arched neon typography + horizontal foreground element.
